description: R08 Host ScreenBuffer reverse-line-feed checkpoint: existing safe Rust vertical-scroll ownership directly reproduces the three Microsoft RI cases for ordinary viewport coordinates.

entries.notes: VerticalScrollState::reverse_index directly reproduces all three Microsoft cases: below the viewport top RI decrements Y while preserving X; at the viewport top RI pins the cursor and scrolls content down one row; and the same behavior holds when the viewport begins below the physical buffer origin.
